what_happened: Task description and ruling both carry successor 3 (delete review-stack-prepare.sh) as ordered after nothing with no caller; live tree shows milestone-review-handoff.sh now calls it (692 closed as written) and two context docs cite it as the live ref-plumbing implementation (690), so successor 3 must be ordered after successors 4 and 1.

The task description directs an autonomous dispatch to create six task records via /task and write edges onto them. multi-task-creation-standard.md's 'Requesting a Proposal Packet, Not Filing, From an Autonomous Dispatch' section names exactly this as a forbidden shape: confirmed creation is foreground-only and AskUserQuestion is withheld from dispatched subagents; state-write.sh's audit-evidence gate would need a human-authored override. The research report flagged the interactive steps as an unresolved risk without reading the standard. The plan re-shapes implementation to the required shape: a creation-ready proposal packet, one follow_up_task issue entry per candidate, and a foreground runbook; only the two description revisions (sanctioned mechanical route) are performed by the dispatch.

The research report states neither 694 nor 655 has a plans/ directory. 655 has an empty plans/ directory (plus empty reports/ and summaries/); 694 has no task directory at all. The conclusion (Description Update path for both, since no plan file exists) stands; the plan states the checkable condition as 'no plan file' rather than 'no plans directory'.

suite_selection_select maps the data files specs/state.json and a task's issues.jsonl to the suites that exercise their writers (over 80 suites for specs/state.json). A plan phase that only edits two description fields through state-write.sh therefore cannot make a Tier Justification the advisory validator accepts unless it names no suite at all: a sub-case (a) sentinel claim is flagged false, and naming example suites is flagged as under-verifying. plan-format.md's sub-case (a) text says a specs-only set is covered by validate-artifact or a diff read-through, which the selector's output contradicts for these two paths.

Packet carries sixteen edges where the plan and report carry fifteen. narrow_handoff_to_print_slice and slice_bar_measurement_and_declaration were unordered but both reconcile agent-system/extensions/core/index-entries.json line counts (each edits a context document registered there, verified by grep), so the batching rule's unordered-overlap edge was added: the handoff record after the bar record. Territory-only and operator-reversible; recorded in the packet's edge_count.delta_from_plan. Also: the ruling names skills/skill-git-workflow/SKILL.md as a /merge mention but the ruling's own search finds none there, so it was left out of remove_merge_command's file_scope and flagged for that record's research.

Every carried figure in the plan's premise table re-measured unchanged at implementation time (state baseline, statuses of 655/690-697, three greps, file sizes); no description needed a corrected figure. The description's own claim that successor 3 is independent stays false, as the report found.
